title: Umbris — Mental Breakdown
summary: Exile-theft control turns every opponent's missing card into Umbris power, then wins through shadow, copies, or a power-based shot.

tags.name: commander matters
tags.reason: Umbris converts every opponent-owned card in exile into the deck's primary damage engine.

tags.name: exile
tags.reason: Forty cards exile opposing libraries, hands, graveyards, spells, or permanents.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Shared Fate and repeatable theft engines make opponents' cards the deck's main source of value.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Shared Fate and Knowledge Pool replace normal draws and hand-casting with communal exile decisions.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: Exile removal, graveyard clearing, counters, and library extraction regulate the table while Umbris grows.

tags.name: clones
tags.reason: Four nonlegendary-copy effects multiply Umbris-sized threats or turn an established board into finishers.

tags.name: voltron
tags.reason: Evasion and protection support commander-damage kills from an exile-inflated Umbris.

tags.name: prison
tags.reason: The namesake enchantment package constrains normal draw and casting without creating a hard lock.
